findings.costIfIgnored: Lost bookings and customer accounts mean lost deposits and a full day of manual rebuild from messages.
findings.fixPrompt: Add nightly backup for salon.db to durable object storage and document restore steps in README plus add startup log showing backup location and last success time.
findings.plain: If the computer or disk holding salon.db is lost, all accounts, services and bookings disappear with it. There is no copy or restore step shown in the material.
findings.title: All bookings live in one file with no backup

findings.costIfIgnored: Stolen accounts, fake held slots and extra Paystack checks cost money and turn away real customers on busy days.
findings.fixPrompt: Add in memory rate limiting to auth and booking routes with 429 response and Retry After header, using separate strict limits for register, login and verify, and log repeated blocks.
findings.plain: A script can try many login codes on login or create many pending bookings and payment checks. Real customers would see slow pages or blocked slots while the owner sees strange accounts.
findings.title: Login and booking can be retried without slowing down

findings.costIfIgnored: Outages sit unseen until morning complaints, with lost deposits and many hours to guess what broke.
findings.fixPrompt: Add health endpoint plus structured JSON logs for startup, login errors, booking errors and Paystack verify errors, and wire an external uptime check with alert to owner email or phone.
findings.plain: If the app crashes at night or Paystack verification starts breaking, nobody is alerted. The only sign is a line in the server console that nobody watches.
findings.title: No alert when the app stops or payments break

findings.costIfIgnored: Peak season brings logouts, double booked confusion and very slow admin list when it is needed most.
findings.fixPrompt: Move sessions to persistent store, add pagination and indexes to booking queries for slots, my bookings and admin list, and load test with ten times current rows to show response time.
findings.plain: With ten times the bookings, the in memory login store fills and restarts log everyone out, and the single salon.db file plus full booking scans slow the booking and admin pages.
findings.title: Sessions and single database will struggle as visits grow

findings.costIfIgnored: Unpaid chairs look booked, real customers are turned away and cash is lost at reconciliation.
findings.fixPrompt: Mark demo bookings with clear unpaid status and banner in admin and My bookings, block demo confirm in production by env flag, and add admin action to convert to paid after real receipt.
findings.plain: When Paystack keys are missing, a click on OK marks the booking confirmed with no money moved. The owner sees confirmed status and may hold a chair for an unpaid customer.
findings.quote: Payment: Demo path when secret key is missing marks booking confirmed with DEMO plus reference and no real charge, after OK on confirm dialog
findings.title: Demo bookings look confirmed with no real payment
